017package org.apache.juneau.http.header;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.util.*;
022import java.util.function.*;
023
024import org.apache.juneau.commons.http.*;
025
026/**
027 * Base type for headers whose value is a single {@link MediaType} (e.g. {@code Content-Type}).
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack
031 * ({@code org.apache.juneau.marshall.ng.*}).
032 *
033 * @since 9.2.1
034 */
035@SuppressWarnings({
036   "java:S2160", // equals() on HttpHeaderBean uses name + getValue(); typed state is reflected in getValue()
037   "unchecked" // Supplier<?> branches cast to typed suppliers after lazy-mode check
038})
039public class HttpMediaTypeHeader extends HttpHeaderBean {
040
041   public static final int LAZY_WIRE_STRING = 0;
042   public static final int LAZY_MEDIA_TYPE = 1;
043
044   private final MediaType cachedForStringOrDirect;
045   private final Supplier<?> lazySupplier;
046   private final int lazyMode;
047
048   /**
049    * Constructor.
050    *
051    * @param name Header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
052    * @param value Wire value. Can be <jk>null</jk>, in which case the parsed value is <jk>null</jk>.
053    */
054   protected HttpMediaTypeHeader(String name, String value) {
055      super(name, value);
056      this.cachedForStringOrDirect = parseMediaType(value);
057      this.lazySupplier = null;
058      this.lazyMode = -1;
059   }
060
061   /**
062    * Constructor.
063    *
064    * @param name Header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
065    * @param value The media type value. Can be <jk>null</jk>, in which case the parsed value is <jk>null</jk>.
066    */
067   protected HttpMediaTypeHeader(String name, MediaType value) {
068      super(name, value == null ? null : value.toString());
069      this.cachedForStringOrDirect = value;
070      this.lazySupplier = null;
071      this.lazyMode = -1;
072   }
073
074   /**
075    * Constructor with lazy value supplier.
076    *
077    * @param name Header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
078    * @param supplier The lazy value supplier. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
079    * @param lazyMode Either {@link #LAZY_WIRE_STRING} or {@link #LAZY_MEDIA_TYPE}.
080    */
081   protected HttpMediaTypeHeader(String name, Supplier<?> supplier, int lazyMode) {
082      super(name, lazyMode == LAZY_WIRE_STRING
083         ? ((Supplier<String>) supplier)::get
084         : () -> {
085            var m = ((Supplier<MediaType>) supplier).get();
086            if (m == null)
087               return null;
088            return m.toString();
089         });
090      this.cachedForStringOrDirect = null;
091      this.lazySupplier = supplier;
092      this.lazyMode = lazyMode;
093   }
094
095   public Optional<MediaType> asMediaType() {
096      return o(toMediaType());
097   }
098
099   public String getParameter(String name) {
100      return orElse(MediaType.EMPTY).getParameter(name);
101   }
102
103   public List<NameValuePair> getParameters() {
104      return orElse(MediaType.EMPTY).getParameters();
105   }
106
107   public final String getSubType() {
108      return orElse(MediaType.EMPTY).getSubType();
109   }
110
111   public final List<String> getSubTypes() {
112      return orElse(MediaType.EMPTY).getSubTypes();
113   }
114
115   public final String getType() {
116      return orElse(MediaType.EMPTY).getType();
117   }
118
119   public final boolean hasSubType(String value) {
120      return orElse(MediaType.EMPTY).hasSubType(value);
121   }
122
123   public final boolean isMetaSubtype() {
124      return orElse(MediaType.EMPTY).isMetaSubtype();
125   }
126
127   /**
128    * Returns the index of the best-matching media type in the specified list.
129    *
130    * @param mediaTypes The media types to match against. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
131    * @return The index of the best match, or <c>-1</c> if no suitable match was found.
132    */
133   public int match(List<MediaType> mediaTypes) {
134      var matchQuant = 0;
135      var matchIndex = -1;
136      for (var i = 0; i < mediaTypes.size(); i++) {
137         var mt = mediaTypes.get(i);
138         var matchQuant2 = mt.match(orElse(MediaType.EMPTY), true);
139         if (matchQuant2 > matchQuant) {
140            matchQuant = matchQuant2;
141            matchIndex = i;
142         }
143      }
144      return matchIndex;
145   }
146
147   public final int match(MediaType o, boolean allowExtraSubTypes) {
148      return orElse(MediaType.EMPTY).match(o, allowExtraSubTypes);
149   }
150
151   /**
152    * Returns the parsed value of this header, or the specified default if unset.
153    *
154    * @param other The default value. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
155    * @return The parsed value, or <c>other</c> if the value is unset. Can be <jk>null</jk> if <c>other</c> is <jk>null</jk>.
156    */
157   public MediaType orElse(MediaType other) {
158      var x = toMediaType();
159      return nn(x) ? x : other;
160   }
161
162   /**
163    * Returns the parsed value of this header.
164    *
165    * @return The parsed value, or <jk>null</jk> if the value is unset.
166    */
167   public MediaType toMediaType() {
168      if (lazyMode == LAZY_MEDIA_TYPE)
169         return ((Supplier<MediaType>) lazySupplier).get();
170      if (cachedForStringOrDirect != null)
171         return cachedForStringOrDirect;
172      return parseMediaType(super.getValue());
173   }
174
175   private static MediaType parseMediaType(String value) {
176      if (!nn(value))
177         return null;
178      var v = value;
179      var i = v.indexOf(',');
180      if (i != -1)
181         v = v.substring(i + 1);
182      return MediaType.of(v);
183   }
184}
